schema.text: When you travel by car, does the lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff) make you feel less secure?

ar.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: عند التنقل بالسيارة، هل يُضعف غياب المراقبة أو إجراءات الأمن (مثل عدم وجود كاميرات أو موظفين) شعورك بالأمان؟

de.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: Fühlen Sie sich bei Autofahrten durch fehlende Überwachung oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen (z. B. keine Kameras, kein Personal) weniger sicher?

en.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: When you travel by car, does the lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff) make you feel less secure?

fa.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: هنگام سفر با خودرو، آیا نبود نظارت یا تدابیر امنیتی (مثلاً نبود دوربین یا کارکنان) باعث می‌شود احساس امنیت کمتری کنید؟

fr.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité à cause du manque de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméras, pas de personnel) ?

hu.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: Autós utazás közben kevésbé érzi magát biztonságban a felügyelet vagy a biztonsági intézkedések hiánya (pl. nincs kamera, nincs személyzet) miatt?

it.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: Quando viaggi in auto, la mancanza di sorveglianza o di misure di sicurezza (es. niente telecamere, niente personale) ti fa sentire meno al sicuro?

tr.#When you travel by car, does the lack o: Arabayla yolculuk ederken gözetim veya güvenlik önlemlerinin eksikliği (örn. kamera yok, görevli yok) kendinizi daha az güvende hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
